Architecture Summary: How Pages Are Read, Processed, and Written ### Overview This is a minimal static site generator (SSG) CLI tool written in TypeScript. It takes a directory of markdown files (with optional YAML frontmatter), converts them to HTML pages using inline HTML templates (string literals), and writes the output to a specified directory along with an `index.html` listing page. ### Data Flow ``` CLI (index.ts) | | parseArgs() parses "ssg build --content ./content --output ./dist" | v generateSite(contentDir, outputDir) | v readContentDirectory(contentDir) |-- Reads directory entries via fs.readdirSync |-- Filters for *.md files only |-- For each .md file, calls parseMarkdownFile() | |-- fs.readFileSync reads raw file contents | |-- gray-matter extracts frontmatter (data) and markdown body (content) | |-- marked.parse() converts markdown to HTML | |-- slug derived from filename (basename minus .md extension) | |-- Returns a Page { title, date, tags, content (HTML), slug } |-- Returns Page[] | v For each Page: |-- renderPage(page) wraps HTML content in a full HTML5 template | (includes DOCTYPE, head with title/meta keywords, nav link home, | article with h1 title, optional time element, content div) |-- fs.writeFileSync writes to outputDir/.html | v renderIndex(pages) creates index.html |-- An unordered list with links to each page, optional dates and tags |-- fs.writeFileSync writes to outputDir/index.html | v Returns count = pages.length + 1 (including index.html) ``` ### Key Components 1. **Entry Point** (`src/index.ts`): - Parses CLI args. Only supports `build` command with `--content` and `--output` options. - Defaults: `content=./content`, `output=./dist`. - Calls `generateSite()` and exits with code 0 on success, 1 on failure. 2. **Core Generator** (`src/generator.ts`): - **`parseMarkdownFile(filePath)`**: The single-file parser. Reads raw text, extracts frontmatter via `gray-matter`, renders markdown to HTML via `marked.parse()`, and builds a `Page` object. Handles Date objects from gray-matter by converting to ISO date strings. - **`readContentDirectory(contentDir)`**: Directory scanner. Returns empty array for missing dirs. Filters `.md` files only. One level deep (no recursion into subdirectories). - **`renderPage(page)`**: HTML template for individual pages. Includes: DOCTYPE, meta charset/viewport, title, optional keywords meta tag, nav link to index, article with h1 title, optional time element, and the HTML content in a div. - **`renderIndex(pages)`**: HTML template for the index page listing all pages. - **`generateSite(contentDir, outputDir)`**: Orchestrator. Reads all pages, creates output dir if needed, writes individual page HTML files plus index.html, returns file count. ### Frontmatter Handling - Uses `gray-matter` v4 for YAML frontmatter parsing - Supported frontmatter fields: - **`title`** (string): Page title. Falls back to slug (filename without extension) if not present. - **`date`** (string or Date): Publication date. If gray-matter parses it as a `Date` object, it is converted to `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Empty string if not present. - **`tags`** (string[]): Array of tags. Defaults to empty array `[]` if not present. ### Template Handling - **No external template files or template engine.** HTML is generated via inline template literals (backtick strings) directly in the `renderPage()` and `renderIndex()` functions. - Individual pages use one hardcoded layout; the index page uses a different hardcoded layout. - There is no support for partials, layouts, includes, or user-customizable templates. ### Rendering Pipeline 1. Raw `.md` file text is read synchronously 2. `gray-matter` splits it into `{ data, content }` 3. `marked.parse(content)` converts markdown body to HTML string (handles the edge case where marked v4 might return an object instead of string) 4. HTML is interpolated into the template literal 5. Result is written to disk as a `.html` file ### Test Architecture - 14 tests in 4 describe blocks, all passing - Tests use a temporary directory (`.test-tmp`) created/cleaned per test - **`parseMarkdownFile`** tests (5): Frontmatter parsing, missing title fallback, title-only frontmatter, code blocks, empty frontmatter - **`readContentDirectory`** tests (4): Missing dir, empty dir, multiple files, non-markdown filtering - **`generateSite`** tests (4): Full generation with tags/date, empty dir, auto-creating output dir, pages without tags - **`index.html generation`** tests (1): Verifies links to all pages appear in index ### Current Limitations / Gaps - **No template customization**: Users cannot provide their own templates - **No subdirectory recursion**: Only `.md` files directly in the content directory are processed; no nested folder support - **No static asset copying**: CSS, images, JS are not copied to the output - **No page ordering**: Pages are listed in filesystem order (not by date) - **No live reload or watch mode** - **Single command only** (`build`): No `dev`, `serve`, or `init` commands

All 28 tests pass (14 existing + 14 new). Here's a summary of what was implemented:

**New file: `src/templates.ts`** — `TemplateEngine` class that:
- Loads `.hbs` Handlebars templates from `./templates/`, `./templates/layouts/`, and `./templates/partials/`
- Registers partials globally via `Handlebars.registerPartial`
- Renders pages through optional template → layout pipeline with `{{{body}}}` placeholder
- Renders index page through the `index` layout or falls back to `default`
- Returns `null` when no templates directory exists (for fallback behavior)

**Updated: `src/generator.ts`**
- `Page` interface now has optional `layout` and `template` fields, extracted from frontmatter
- `generateSite()` accepts optional `templatesDir` parameter; uses `TemplateEngine` when available, falls back to hardcoded HTML otherwise

**Updated: `src/index.ts`** — Added `--templates <dir>` CLI option

**Template files created:**
- `templates/layouts/default.hbs` — default layout with header/footer partials and `{{{body}}}`
- `templates/partials/header.hbs`, `footer.hbs`, `nav.hbs` — reusable partials

**Tests added:** 14 new tests covering frontmatter layout/template extraction, TemplateEngine rendering (default layout, custom layout, page templates, partials, index with default/index layout), generateSite with templates (full generation, frontmatter-specified layout/template, index generation), and fallback behavior.
